definition: Include when a first-listed or documented co-first author, or the last-listed author, has verified DCEG membership around publication; otherwise include when any author has verified DCEG membership and the first-listed author reports an NIH affiliation on the paper.
former_member_policy: After departure, require a paper-specific DCEG link or researcher confirmation. Former employment alone is insufficient.
date_policy: Earliest known publication date; no arbitrary appointment grace period. Unclear timing remains unresolved.
collective_authors: Do not substitute a consortium's preceding author for the last-listed author. Collective endpoints require review unless another inclusion route qualifies.
notes: NIH funding, an NIH email alone, and former NIH affiliation alone do not satisfy the first-author NIH requirement. Publication types and source-discovery cutoff remain separate policies.
